tool.name: Read 10X Counts (HDF5)
tool.description: import single-cell counts from a 10X HDF5 file

param.name: infile
param.label: HDF5 file
param.help: HDF5 file containing counts data in the 10X sparse HDF5 format.

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Sample name stored in the cell metadata. Particularly useful to track the sample of origin for each cell after merging multiple datasets.

tool.help:
**Read 10X Counts (HDF5)**
Creates a SingleCellExperiment from the CellRanger HDF5 file format for 10X Genomics data, saved in H5AD format.
**Inputs**
- *HDF5 file* (h5): HDF5 file containing counts data in the 10X sparse HDF5 format.
**Outputs**
- *H5AD file* (h5ad): H5AD file exported from the SingleCellExperiment object using anndataR.
This tool was generated automatically by BiocJobs from the job specification `read-10x-counts-h5` shipped in Bioconductor package **DropletUtils**.
